## What changed

- Merged upstream lat.md 0.13.4 through 0.13.8.
- `lat ui --host <address>` shares the UI on the network in read-only mode. Only public Markdown and linked public files are visible. The default is still `127.0.0.1`.
- `lat init --experimental` lets you opt in to experimental features per project. The first one, commit hooks, checks staged docs at `git commit` instead of at the end of each agent turn.
- Pre-commit validation can check the working tree instead of the index, with `lat.git-pre-commit.validation: working-tree`.
- On Git 2.54 and newer, the pre-commit hook uses Git's configured hooks and keeps existing hook scripts and managers.
- Fixed: table columns in documents and search previews had no minimum width, so text could become unreadable.
- Fixed: `lat check` was several times slower with multiple local external-source overrides.
- The fork's `PostToolUse` comment-reminder hook is still installed for Claude, Codex, and Cursor, including when commit hooks are enabled.
